title: Beasley Media Group Named Official Audio Partner Of Vegas Golden Knights
summary: VEGAS (September 28, 2026) – Beasley Media Group has been named the official year-round audio partner of the Vegas Golden Knights, launching a multiyear
body_markdown:
**VEGAS (September 28, 2026)** – Beasley Media Group has been named the official year-round audio partner of the Vegas Golden Knights, launching a multiyear agreement that will deliver English- and Spanish-language game broadcasts and expanded VGK programming across Beasley’s audio and digital platforms. The VGK Radio Network is presented by Lee’s Discount Liquor.


Under the agreement, X 107.9 (KVGS FM) will serve as the team’s official English-language radio flagship, while 105.7 Maxima (KOAS FM) will become the Spanish-language radio home of the Golden Knights. The two-station structure will broaden access to live game coverage while serving the diverse audiences that follow the team throughout Southern Nevada.


**Dan D’Uva** and


**Gary Lawless** will return for their 10th season as the Golden Knights’ official English-language radio broadcast team, with D’Uva handling play-by-play and Lawless providing analysis. X 107.9 will broadcast all of Vegas’ games during the 2026-27 season with D’Uva and Lawless.


**Doug Lattuca** will serve as host of the broadcasts on X 107.9, providing live coverage from every pregame, postgame, and intermission.


**Jesus Lopez** and


**Alex Romo** will also return to the Golden Knights and Beasley Media Group team as the Spanish-language play-by-play voice on 105.7 Maxima (KOAS-FM).


The VGK Insider Show will return with


**Daren Millard** as host of the hour-long program on X 107.9. The show will air each weekday from 5 to 6 p.m. PT and feature consistent appearances from


**Kelly McCrimmon** , the General Manager of the Golden Knights, as well as players and broadcasters from the team and other personalities around the NHL. The VGK Insider Show will make its debut for the season on Monday, Sept. 28 on X 107.9.


The Henderson Silver Knights will broadcast on X 107.9 and


96.3 KKLZ-HD2


with full pregame and postgame coverage, carrying all 72 regular-season games and the Calder Cup Playoffs.


**Brian McCormack** will provide play-by-play and


**Darren Eliot** will serve as color analyst as the Silver Knights celebrate their seventh American Hockey League season.


“We’re excited to partner with Beasley Media Group as we continue to advance our brand and connect with more fans throughout Las Vegas and Southern Nevada. With 107.9 X as our flagship station and 105.7 Maxima serving as our Spanish-language home, we’ll be able to reach fans across the region through our radio broadcasts,” said


**John Penhollow** , President of Business Operations for the Vegas Golden Knights. “This partnership gives us a great opportunity to connect with our fans in new and meaningful ways throughout the year, not just on game days, and will broaden the connection to the Golden Knights and the future stars with the Silver Knights.”


“Las Vegas is the sports and entertainment capital of the world, and the Golden Knights are the team that made it so. Beasley’s four Las Vegas stations reach every corner of this valley, and now every one of them carries the team — with X 107.9 as the home of the Golden Knights and Máxima as their Spanish-language home,” said


**Kevin LeGrett** , chief business officer at Beasley Media Group.


The agreement expands Beasley’s presence in live sports and creates an integrated platform for Golden Knights programming across broadcast radio, digital audio, podcasts and other content channels. It also provides the team and its partners with year-round opportunities to reach fans in Las Vegas and throughout the Golden Knights’ radio affiliate network.


**ABOUT THE VEGAS GOLDEN KNIGHTS**


The Vegas Golden Knights are a National Hockey League franchise owned and operated by Black Knight Sports and Entertainment LLC. Established by Owner and Chairman Bill Foley and his family, the Golden Knights were the most successful expansion franchise in North American professional sports history in 2017-18 and won the Stanley Cup in 2022-23. **ABOUT THE HENDERSON SILVER KNIGHTS**


The Henderson Silver Knights are the American Hockey League affiliate of the Vegas Golden Knights. The Silver Knights are owned in part by Bill Foley and his family and operated by the Foley Entertainment Group. The Silver Knights play their home games at Lee’s Family Forum, a state-of-the-art arena in Henderson, NV. For the latest news and information on the Silver Knights visit

**ABOUT BEASLEY MEDIA GROUP**


Beasley Media Group LLC is a multiplatform media company providing advertising and digital marketing solutions across the United States. The company owns and operates radio properties located in 49 large and mid-size markets across the country and offers capabilities in audio technology, podcasting, e-commerce and events. Beasley Media Group reaches over 20 million consumers weekly through on-air, online and digital platforms.
